verdicts.why: Never Meet Your Heroes: Clint takes Cooper, Lila and Nathaniel to Rogers: The Musical, the family leaves midway, eats at a Chinese restaurant and sees the Rockefeller tree. Text and card lines are true.

Partners, Am I Right?: Laura researches Sloan Limited, agrees to check the watch's transmitter signal and texts Clint the address 3715 Godrey Road while he stays in New York. They also speak by phone in ep 1 and 2, but ep 4 is not wrong for this text.
Never Meet Your Heroes: Lila leaves the theater, finds Clint outside, says Natasha was his best friend and hugs him; the family then abandons the show. Card lines are true.

value.title: Hawkeye#1
value.text: Clint takes Nathaniel and his siblings to New York for Christmas. Nathaniel gives away to his mother that they left the musical early, and Clint carries him into the hotel room at the end of the night.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Clint's youngest son, on a Christmas trip with him to New York.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Nathaniel's dad, who takes the kids to New York for Christmas.

verdicts.why: They deal with each other in ep 1, but the source says Nathaniel is carried inside and falls asleep only once set down on the couch, not that he is carried back asleep. Rest is true.
Hide and Seek: Laura picks the kids up at the airport and they build gingerbread houses while she learns by phone that Clint is staying another day. Text and card lines are true.

Avengers: Endgame: on Clint's quantum test trip to the farmhouse, Lila shouts 'Cooper! Where. Are. My. Headphones?' and Cooper answers 'I never had them'; both are dusted at the picnic and restored in the Blip.
Never Meet Your Heroes: back at the hotel, Cooper and Lila sit down to watch the news report on Ronin's reappearance together. Card lines are true.
Never Meet Your Heroes: Cooper and Nathaniel leave the show together shortly after Lila and meet Clint and Lila outside.
Hide and Seek: Laura picks Lila and her brothers up at the airport and makes gingerbread houses with them while Clint stays in New York.
Avengers: Endgame picnic: Laura and Cooper praise Nathaniel's throwing, Laura asks 'Nate, mayo or mustard?' and agrees to give him ketchup; both are dusted and return in the Blip.
Never Meet Your Heroes: Laura calls the family at dinner to ask about the musical and Nathaniel tells her they left midway through.
Never Meet Your Heroes: Nathaniel wants three more crabs and Lila warns he will vomit if he eats any more.

value.title: The Marvels
value.text: Aamir is left with broken glasses when Kree soldiers wreck the Khan home in Kamala's fight, and demands to know where his sister is when she swaps away. When she leaves to face Dar-Benn, he tells her not to die because he doesn't want to be an only child.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Aamir's sister, whose fight wrecks the family home.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Kamala's brother, who asks her to come home safe.

verdicts.why: They do deal with each other, but Aamir does not fight off the Kree (he hits one with a coat rack, gets punched and hides while Carol, Kamala and Monica fight) and 'Come back safely' is Yusuf's line; Aamir's is 'You better. I don't wanna be an only child.'
The Marvels: Aamir leaps over the couch to help when a Kree guard attacks Muneeba, and at the Rambeau house he jokingly mutes her with a remote after her 'raise a family' remark.

Cooper and Laura, and Lila and Nathaniel, share the picnic and the Snap but no line or moment passes between them; the binding rules say a stage is what happens between the two, and a shared event where they never deal with each other is not one. Both ties already exist from Age of Ultron, so nothing is dropped.
